lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after pet/companion selection, wait time countdowns, pet control tutorial screens, personality headlines, and specific hints (duration, account sync, pet persistence) consistently won.
Major redesigns, trait selector sub-flows, photo guidance copy, benefits story copy, path time headlines, account recovery hints, and reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses yielded mixed results, winning in round 1 but hurting performance in round 3.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, trait selector flows, copy changes, and reordering sign-in after photo upload.
Predictions underestimated gains for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety/persistence hints.

candidates.title: Desktop tray icon control tutorial screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated tutorial screen before the final welcome screen explaining desktop tray icon controls and pet visibility toggles.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to reveal, control, or hide their pet after setup.

new_tray_guide.headline: System Tray Controls
new_tray_guide.body: Your companion lives in your system tray. Click the tray icon to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a tutorial screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Pet control tutorial screens consistently win and target support confusion at finish step.

candidates.title: Pet mascot greeting screen
candidates.change: Adds an engaging mascot greeting screen prior to path selection to introduce the desktop pet concept.
candidates.why: Path selection drop-off is 15.4% and has long decision times; introducing the mascot early sets warm expectations.

new_mascot_intro.headline: Meet Your Virtual Buddy
new_mascot_intro.body: Choose a companion path to customize a desktop pet tailored to your daily routine.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a mascot greeting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding sub-flow screens before path selection adds friction and typically hurts performance.

candidates.title: Adoption certificate badge highlight sub-flow
candidates.change: Replaces the default certificate stamp with an official pet verification badge element on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (69.3%); reinforcing pet ownership value increases completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion profile is registered and ready for desktop deployment.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

candidates.title: Full-bleed story screen layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the onboarding story intro screen using a full-bleed visual layout for an immersive first impression.
candidates.why: Initial story presentation sets the tone; full-bleed layout improves visual engagement right at entry.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience
story.body: Bring your computer to life with a pet that responds to your workspace activities.

guard.reason: Valid full-bleed layout redesign of the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Major redesigns and story visual changes consistently hurt conversion in past tests.

candidates.title: Account sign-in security reassurance hint
candidates.change: Adds an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in locks in pet retention.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion profile and prevents pet progress reset.

guard.reason: Valid account persistence hint on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Top support issue addressed directly by pet persistence hint, a proven winning pattern.

candidates.title: Waiting screen live progress timer
candidates.change: Enables countdown timer estimates and step progress counter on the waiting screen while rendering the pet model.
candidates.why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s; showing active live timer feedback reduces drop-off during rendering.

waiting.hint: Generating 3D assets and desktop rendering models...

guard.reason: Valid time estimate and progress counter during a real wait.

candidates.score_note: Wait countdowns consistently win and directly address long rendering wait duration.

candidates.title: Companion archetype choice headline copy
candidates.change: Updates path selection screen headline to focus on selecting a daily companion archetype.
candidates.why: Personality-focused headlines won in past tests by providing immediate clarity on path choice benefits.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Companion Archetype
choose_path.body: Pick the companion dynamic that best matches your work style.

guard.reason: Valid headline and body copy update for path selection.

candidates.score_note: Personality headlines consistently won in historical tests despite general copy test weakness.

candidates.title: Desktop taskbar pet location hint
candidates.change: Adds a helpful hint on the final setup screen detailing where the pet icon is located on the taskbar.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop or users failing to find open instances.

home_intro.hint: Your pet operates in the background. Click the taskbar icon anytime to bring it to the foreground.

guard.reason: Valid hint addition on the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Specific hints address known user confusion at the highest drop-off finish stage.

candidates.title: Wait screen ready notification toggle
candidates.change: Adds an opt-in completion notification alert on the wait screen so users can safely switch windows during rendering.
candidates.why: Long mean wait duration (over 38 minutes) leads to app abandonment without completion alerts.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you when your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Valid opt-in completion notification toggle on the wait screen.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes showed no clear effect in previous testing rounds.

candidates.title: Compact finish screen layout
candidates.change: Switches the home intro screen layout to compact mode with direct launch CTAs.
candidates.why: Finish stage mean duration is 5815s; compact layout speeds up final onboarding exit into active pet use.

guard.reason: Valid layout switch to compact mode on the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Layout modifications showed mixed/no clear historical effect, but finish layout had mild positive lift.
